drivingQuestion: Why does the mishna list only the two loaves and shewbread as wholly for the priests?

segments.he: שְׁתֵּי הַלֶּחֶם וְלֶחֶם הַפָּנִים, וְתוּ לֵיכָּא? וְהָא אִיכָּא חַטַּאת הָעוֹף! אִיכָּא דָּמָהּ.
segments.en: § According to the mishna, with regard to «the two loaves and the shewbread,» the power of the priests is greater than the power of the altar. The Gemara asks: «And are there no more» cases of sacrificial items that are given completely to the priests, with none of their parts placed upon the altar? «But isn’t there the bird» sacrificed as a «sin offering,» which is eaten entirely by the priests, and none of it is placed upon the altar? The Gemara answers: «There is its blood,» which is sprinkled upon the altar.

moves.cueHe: ותו ליכא? והא איכא חטאת העוף
moves.summary: the bird sin offering too goes wholly to the priests
moves.about: the bird sin offering is also eaten wholly by the priests

moves.summary: its blood goes to the altar
moves.about: its blood is sprinkled on the altar
